rationale.consistency: Follows cobra flag/validation idioms, cmdutil.FlagErrorf, MutuallyExclusive, and git client method style; reuses existing HasLocalBranch/CheckoutNewBranch/Pull rather than shelling out ad hoc.
rationale.edge_cases: Blank path, --checkout requirement, --list exclusivity, relative→absolute, leaf-symlink/non-dir guard, same-repo/other-repo/nested-worktree rejection, reuse of existing linked worktree, and ff-only pull warning are all covered.
rationale.scope: Delivers the flag, git helper, shared resolver and help text; extra but related refactor replaces localBranchExists with HasLocalBranch and exports WorktreeCheckoutCommands used by only one caller.
rationale.readability: Clear names and doc comments; WorktreeAdd's empty-remote mode switch and the long semicolon-heavy Long help paragraph are the weak spots.
rationale.robustness: Errors propagated everywhere, validation runs before any API mutation, no panics; pull failure degrades to a warning matching the existing checkout flow.
rationale.maintainability: Path rules are centralised, but the 4-way reuse/branch-exists decision is duplicated between shared.WorktreeCheckoutCommands and develop's checkoutBranchInWorktree, and develop checks opts.Worktree while also carrying worktree.Path.
